thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning a short webinar next Tue to tee up the new pricing page and the pricing calculator A/B test. Need copy for tiers + an updated FAQ. Who can jump on a quick sync?

sam: I can. 11am PT works for me. Webinar goal: reduce inbound sales asks by making committed vs metered clear, and surface Dedicated benefits.

joni: I’ll bring proposed tier names. Leaning toward: 'Starter / Scale / Committed' vs 'Developer / Team / Enterprise'.

kevin: Any preference data? Last usability session showed people confused by the word "Committed" vs "Reserved". Maybe spell it out like 'Committed (reserved capacity & discounts)'.

elaine: For the FAQ we should add Q: "When should I choose Dedicated vs Hosted?" with a 2-line answer + bullet examples (startup, high-throughput ecom, regulated). Also routing: webinar signups -> marketing nurture; calculator "request a quote" -> AE ticket.

maria: Draft microcopy idea for tier blurbs: 'Starter — low-volume dev testing', 'Scale — predictable performance with autoscale', 'Committed — reserved capacity + volume pricing'. Short and scannable.

sam: Also want a 30s demo in the webinar showing the calculator toggling batching and quantization and the resulting cost delta. Can infra provide a deterministic example?

launchbot: Reminder: legal review required 48h before publish. Please attach copy to the legal queue.

joni: Copy test candidates (short):
  1) Developer / Team / Enterprise
  2) Starter / Growth / Committed
  3) Pay-as-you-go / Reserved / Enterprise
Thoughts?

kevin: I prefer option 2 for clarity. Option 1 is generic; option 3 mixes billing model into the name which might confuse people.

maria: Let's A/B test option 2 vs option 1 on the hero. Metric: CTA click -> signup conversion. Also change calculator CTA depending on inputs: 'Estimate monthly cost' for small results, 'Request a quote' when results hit committed thresholds.

elaine: Inbound routing proposal: GTM rule — if calc result > $5k/mo, auto-assign lead to AE queue; otherwise send user into self-serve nurture flow. Growth ops can we implement that rule and events?

sam: Growth ops — cc @joni for tracking. Event names we agreed on: pricing_calculator_result and pricing_cta_click.

joni: I'll draft the FAQ bullets and both headline variants by EOD. Who can record the 30s demo?

kevin: I can record a short screen capture with mocked requests and stable numbers, then upload to the webinar folder.

maria: Awesome. Meeting confirmed 11am PT tomorrow. Agenda: 1) Tier names + hero variants 2) FAQ microcopy 3) Calculator demo + routing rules 4) Launch timeline. :calendar:

sam: Sounds good. I'll add A/B test tracking to the doc. :+1:

elaine: Will queue the FAQ copy for legal once you post it, maria.

maria: Thanks team — see you tomorrow.
